notes.title: 《Rail of Möbius》Demo Version 0.7.0 Update
notes.content:
[h3]
The English version of the DEMO is on STEAM with a small update (version 0.7.0), improving the problem that some players cannot read the path correctly.

The DEMO content is about one-eighth of the game.

Welcome to download and play for free and thank you for your support.

[/h3]

notes.title: 《Rail of Möbius》Digital Art Book Update - Add prequel novel pictures
notes.content:

In addition, the pictures of Cecilia and Luna drawn by Mr. Moke have been added. 
Welcome to update the collection!
